name: Readiness Parser Fix — pipeline_runs_exist + current_posts + current_qc_pass
goal: Fix dashboard/parsers/readiness.py so that pipeline_runs_exist is accurate (checks workspace/scs001/run-*/ not the non-existent reports/pipeline-runs/), current_posts reads from publish-ledger.jsonl, and current_qc_pass reads from experiments.jsonl. This makes the Phase 1.5 gate readiness panel accurate.
rationale: The readiness endpoint shows pipeline_runs_exist=false and current_posts=0 despite 119+ ledger entries and 10+ run directories. Root cause: wrong run directory path and hardcoded 0 for actuals. The Apr 7 gate decision depends on accurate post counts.
swarm: NOT USED — targeted Python edits, simple fix.

tasks.title: dashboard/parsers/readiness.py — fix pipeline_runs_exist
